integrity: Exact rational polynomial checker verifies the critical formulas; the analytical use of the real-analytic implicit-function theorem and nondegenerate U-statistic CLT is separately proved in RESULT.md. No independent review has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Analytic local family for iid uncensored [0,1] observations. Asymptotic null-law matching of a scalar unstudentized U-statistic only; no exact finite-sample identity, optimal perturbation radius, censoring or parameter-estimation conclusion.
title: Smooth nonuniform laws with the exact Gaussian null limit of a scalar uniformity test
